caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on an otherwise blank, beige background enclosed by a faintly outlined rectangular border. The object resembles an anthropomorphic wolf or canine figure colored in various tones of brown and gray, standing on its hind legs atop a greenish, irregularly shaped base. The wolf has prominent ears, a snout, and a tail. Its left hand is holding a bright red item that appears round, while its right arm is drawn back, bent at the elbow. There are dark lines accentuating details on its limbs, head, and torso, and some areas are highlighted with lighter or yellowish hues, providing depth. The figure faces leftward and is placed slightly below the center of the page. The remaining space inside the border is empty, and the outermost edges of the image show some light discoloration or spotting.
title: Pa. German Figurine
